name: 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia
short_description: A half-marathon event held in Putrajaya, Malaysia on November 1, 2026, offering 21km and 10km distances.
ai_summary: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia is a half-marathon event scheduled for November 1, 2026, in Putrajaya, Malaysia. Organized by Garmin Malaysia with technical partner SCORE Experience, the race offers 21km and 10km distance options, with the 21.1km half-marathon as the primary distance. The event starts in front of Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya.

core_facts.venue: In front of Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya

pros: Eight aid stations about every 2 to 3 km on the 21 km, each with water, medic and toilets
Pacers from 1:45 to 2:30 for the half marathon
Cash prizes five deep in every 21 km category, with thin women's fields
cons: Humid, windless start: 27°C and 89% humidity at 5am in 2025
Race packs collected in Petaling Jaya two weeks before race day in 2025
Warms to 29°C to 31°C by 9am to 9.30am for the slowest finishers
research_highlights: The 2026 Malaysia leg (1 November 2026) takes place in front of Mahkamah Syariah Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya, Bangunan Annexe Istana Kehakiman, Presint 3 — a new start venue compared to previous years' Dataran Putrajaya location.
Race pack collection for the 2026 edition is scheduled for 30 and 31 October 2026, with further logistics details to be announced via Garmin Malaysia's social media.
The event offers 10KM and 21KM (half marathon) categories as its signature distances.
The 2025 edition drew over 13,000 runners to Dataran Putrajaya, up from roughly 12,000 in 2024, making it one of Malaysia's largest running events.

The course runs through Putrajaya's lakeside architectural landmarks and green avenues, an area known for open, exposed roads with little shade — relevant given the early-morning (pre-dawn/sunrise) start typical of the series.

faqs.question: When is the 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia taking place?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on November 1, 2026. It will be held in Putrajaya, Malaysia, starting in front of Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya, and is organized by Garmin Malaysia in partnership with SCORE Experience as the technical partner for the event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The event offers two distances: a 21km half-marathon, which is the primary distance for this race, and a shorter 10km option. This gives participants a choice between two race lengths depending on their preferred level of challenge and training.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by Garmin Malaysia, with SCORE Experience serving as the technical partner responsible for supporting the event's execution. Together, they oversee the 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia, which is held in Putrajaya as part of the broader race series.
